div.div: سَطِيحَةٌ One of the vessels for water; (TA;) a [leathern water-bag of the kind called] مَزَادَة, (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K, TA,) made of two skins (Mgh, TA) placed opposite to each other; it is small, and large; but the مزادة [properly so called] is larger than it; (TA;) and ↓ سَطِيحٌ signifies the same. (S, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
